Online Application.description: Complete and submit your application through the CvSU Online Admission Portal.
instructions: Go to admission.cvsu.edu.ph using a Gmail account.
Fill out the online application form completely and accurately.
Choose the correct entry type or applicant category.
Ensure the declared track or strand matches your documentary requirements.
Review all information before saving and submitting.
Save or update the application every time a change is made.
Upload documentary requirements as individual JPEG, PNG, or BMP pages up to 1MB each.
Use a white-background 2x2 ID photo with a file size of at most 10KB.
requirements: Completed online application form
2x2 ID photo with white background, up to 10KB
Documentary requirements signed by authorized school personnel
Separate scanned pages in JPEG, PNG, or BMP format, up to 1MB each
Online Application.title: Online Application

Validation Appointment.description: Schedule an appointment to have your application documents verified by an admission processor.
instructions: Log in to the CvSU Online Admission Portal using your registered account.
Select an available schedule for document validation.
Download and print the generated Validation or Appointment Slip.
Report to the designated campus office on your scheduled date and time.
Present the original documents and complete photocopies for verification.
requirements: Printed Validation or Appointment Slip
Original and photocopy of Form 138, Report Card, or Transcript of Records
Original and photocopy of PSA Birth Certificate
Certificate of Good Moral Character signed by authorized school personnel
2x2 ID photo with white background
Long brown envelope and long plastic envelope
Validation Appointment.title: Validation Appointment

Admission Examination.description: Take the admission examination at the assigned venue and schedule.
instructions: After document validation, download and print your Test Permit from the admission portal.
Arrive at the designated venue 30 to 45 minutes before the examination.
Bring your Test Permit and valid ID into the examination room.
Follow all examination guidelines; cellphones and unauthorized electronic devices are prohibited.
Monitor the portal or official announcements for examination results.
requirements: Printed Test Permit or Examination Permit
Valid school ID or government-issued ID
No. 2 pencils
Admission Examination.title: Admission Examination

Interview.description: Attend the required program interview and discuss your academic background and course choice.
instructions: Check eligibility and program requirements, especially for quota or board courses.
Check the portal or department notification for your interview schedule and session.
Attend on time in smart casual or official school attire.
Prepare to answer questions about your academic background and course choice.
requirements: Printed Interview Slip or Exam Result Slip
Valid photo ID
Copy of Form 138, Report Card, or Summary of Grades
Interview.location: Designated College or Department Building, such as CEIT, CON, or CED, or the official video conference link for online interviews.
Interview.title: Interview

Medical Examination.description: Complete the required tests and secure an official medical clearance from the university.
instructions: Secure the official Medical Examination Form from the portal or University Health Services Unit.
Undergo the required laboratory tests at a licensed diagnostic facility or hospital.
Report to the University Clinic for a physical examination and submit your test results.
Secure the official Medical Clearance issued by university medical staff.
requirements: Chest X-ray result taken within the last 3 to 6 months
Complete Blood Count result
Urinalysis result
Blood typing result
Completed Medical History Form
2x2 ID photo
details: In-school: Physical examination, dental check-up, and height and weight checks are conducted on campus.
Outside medical: Laboratory tests are taken at external diagnostic centers and presented to the University Clinic for validation.
Medical Examination.title: Medical Examination

Enrollment.description: Submit your original documents, register for subjects, and receive your Certificate of Registration.
instructions: Verify in the portal that Validation, Examination or Interview, and Medical Clearance are completed.
Submit all required original hard-copy documents to the Office of the University Registrar.
Secure your official Certificate of Registration with your subjects and section schedule.
Attend the mandatory student orientation.
requirements: Original Form 138 or Senior High School Report Card
Original Certificate of Good Moral Character
Original PSA Birth Certificate
Official Medical Clearance issued by CvSU Health Services Unit
Printed Admission or Eligibility Slip
2x2 ID photos with white background
Completed Student Personal Data Sheet or Enrollment Form
Enrollment.title: Enrollment

faqItems: Application
How to apply?
The applicant must have a Google email account in order to log in and answer the online admission application form. They must read the posted announcement for guidance.
Application
Can I apply to more than one campus?
No. An applicant cannot apply to more than one campus at the same time because there should only be one application existing for one applicant.
Validation
Can the applicant go or visit the OSAS in advance of the scheduled appointment?
No, it is not advised. The applicant must follow the selected schedule of appointment.
Requirements
Can the requirements of the applicant be followed-up for later?
No, to-follow requirements is not allowed. The date for appointment cannot be selected until the requirements are properly and completely uploaded in the online admission system.
Requirements
What if the attached document is not really the document being required?
The application will be and can be declined due to dishonest application.
Requirements
What if the requirements are not yet complete for online submission? What if my requirements are not yet available?
The online application will not push through until the requirements are correctly and completely uploaded in the online admission system.
Validation
I lived abroad/came from a far place, how can I apply or make appointment?

Kindly follow and read the posted announcement on the procedure how to apply online. You may have an authorized person bring your complete and correct documents to represent you on the appointment date.
Programs
Can I apply for a course that is not aligned to my Track/Strand?
No. The applicant can only apply for a course/program that is aligned to the Track/Strand.
Requirements
Can I use my cellphone to scan or take a picture of my requirements?
Yes.
Application
Can I still edit my information? Can I still change my preferred course? Can I still change the campus I will be applying for?
The information details can still be edited as long as you have not yet selected and saved an appointment date.
Validation
Can the parent/ guardian/ sibling/ classmate/schoolmate or a distant relative represent the applicant at OSAS during the appointment date?
Yes, provided that they will bring an authorization letter from the applicant and a photocopy of the applicant's ID.
Application

How if I have already used my gmail account in applying from the previous admission application (SY2026-2027), can I still use my same gmail account to apply for the current admission application (SY2027-2028)?

Yes, you can still use your existing and the same gmail account to apply for the current admission system (SY2027-2028) even if you have already used your gmail account in applying from the previous application for admission (SY2026-2027). The previous admission system is different from the current admission system.
Requirements
Where can I request the requirement - Certificate of Non-issuance of Form-137? Does it have a request form?
The applicant must request the requirement from their Senior High School. There is no request form for it.
Requirements
Is it okay to submit a scanned copy requirement without a signature of the authorized school personnel?
No. It should have a signature of an authorized school personnel.
Application
If I am currently enrolled for 2nd semester in another school, and I wish to transfer to your University, how can I apply?
The applicant can try to apply; given that he/she can be able to provide all the Certificate of Grades (COG) of all semester/s he/she enrolled in.
Enrollment
I am a former CvSU student. I wanted to study again. How can I be enrolled?
The returnee student of CvSU must coordinate first with their College Registrar.
Using the App
How do I reset my progress in the app?

Open Profile, tap Reset Admission Journey, and confirm Reset progress. This clears your completed steps, checked requirements, and recorded exam result in the guide. Your applicant profile stays saved.
Using the App
How do I edit my applicant profile?
Open Profile and tap Edit Profile. Follow the setup screens, then tap Continue on the last screen to save your choices.
Using the App
How do I get the latest guide content?
Connect to the internet, open Profile, and tap Check for content updates. The app will download the latest published guide when available.
Using the App
Can I use the app without internet?
Yes. You can read the saved or bundled guide and use the campus map offline. You need internet access to download updates or open the official admission portal.
Using the App
Can I use the guide without creating a profile?
Yes. Choose Continue as Guest on the start screen. You can browse the guide, map, and FAQs without saving applicant progress.
Using the App
Can I submit my official application in the app?
Use Open CvSU Admission on Home or Profile to visit the official admission portal. Submit documents, book appointments, and check official results there.
Using the App
How do I use the campus walking guide?
Open Map, tap an admission location marker, and choose a gate or Start walking guide. The character will show the route to the location.
Using the App
Will my progress appear on another device?
The guide saves your profile and progress on the device you use. Switching phones or clearing the app’s storage may require you to set up your profile and track your progress again.

faqTrivia: Did you know Don Severino de las Alas, whom the campus is named after, was the Secretary of the Interior in President Emilio Aguinaldo's cabinet?
Did you know the campus was named after Don Severino de las Alas, who donated much of the land where the main campus stands today?

Did you know the school changed its name five times before becoming Cavite State University: Indang Farm School, Indang Rural High School, Don Severino National Agriculture School, Don Severino Agricultural College, and CvSU in 1998?
Did you know the university also conducts research on kaong, or sugar palm, which is Indang's One Town One Product?
Did you know the famous Laya at Diwa monument at the campus entrance was created by artist Jonnel P. Castrillo and inaugurated in 2006 during CvSU's centennial celebration?
Did you know CvSU Indang hosts the National Coffee Research Center and produces its own coffee brand, the Don Severino Aguinaldo Blend?
Did you know the main campus sits on about 70 hectares of land in Bancod, Indang, roughly 60 kilometers southwest of Manila?
Did you know CvSU became a state university on January 22, 1998, through Republic Act No. 8468, after being Don Severino Agricultural College since 1964?
Did you know CvSU has been accredited by AACCUP and recognized by TESDA as an assessment center?
Did you know the first Filipino principal, Dr. Mariano Mondonedo, took over in 1915 after the school had previously been led by American principals?
Did you know CvSU Indang serves as the main campus and headquarters of the university system, which now has more than 11 campuses across Cavite?
Did you know the Laya at Diwa monument's torch flame has CvSU written on it, and the sculpture represents the university's vision of Truth, Excellence, and Service?
faqTranslations: Paano mag-apply?

Kailangan mayroong Google email account ang aplikante upang makapag-log-in at makapagsagot ng online application form. Kailangan ay nabasa rin ng aplikante ang nakapaskil na anunsyo patungkol sa admission application ng CvSU Main campus (Indang)
Maaari ba akong mag-apply ng higit sa isang Campus na magkasabay?
Hindi. Ang isang aplikante ay hindi pinapagayag magkaroon ng higit sa isang campus na aapplyan na magkasabay dahil kailangang isang application lamang ang dapat umiral sa iisang aplikante.
Maaari bang magpunta ang aplikante sa mas maaga sa scheduled appointment para sa validation?
Hindi. Ito ay hindi pinahihintulutan. Ang aplikante ay kailangang sumunod sa nakatakda o napili nyang schedule of appointment.
Maaari kayang to-follow ang mga requirements?

Hindi. Hindi makakapili ng date for appointment kapag ang mga requirements ay hindi nakumpletong mai-upload sa online admission system. Kailangang mai-upload muna ang lahat ng kumpletong requirements upang magkaroon ng appointment date for validation.
Paano kung ang mga dokumentong nai-upload sa online admission system ay hindi talaga ang totoong dokumentong hinihingi?
Ang aplikasyon ay maaaring hindi matanggap dahil sa hindi naging matapat (dishonest) ng nag-a-apply.
Paano kung ang aking mga requirements ay hindi pa kumpleto o hindi pa available para maipasa online?
Ang aplikasyon ay pansamantala munang matitigil. Uusad lamang ang aplikasyon kapag nai-upload na ang mga requirements at doon ay makakapili na ng date for appointment.
Ako ay nakatira sa ibang bansa o nakatira sa malayong lugar sa Pilipinas. Papaano ako makakapag-apply at makakapili ng appointment date?

Sundin ang mga hakbang upang makapag-apply online sa pamamagitan ng pagbabasa ng anunsyo. Magkaroon ng isang authorized person na pwedeng magdala sa OSAS ng kumpleto at tamang mga requirements sa nakatakdang appointment date.
Maaari ba akong mag-apply sa isang kurso na hindi katugma sa aking track/strand?
Hindi. Ito ay hindi pinahihintulutan. Ang tanging makakapag-apply lamang sa nasabing kurso ay ang mga aplikante na nakahanay sa kanilang track/strand.
Maaari ko bang gamitin ang aking cellphone para mag-picture/screenshot ng aking mga requirements?
Oo, pwedeng gamitin ang cellphone kung walang scanner/printer na magagamit sa pag-scan ng mga requirements.
Pwede ko pa bang iedit ang aking mga impormasyon? Maaari pa ba akong magpalit ng kurso o Campus na gusto kong applyan?
Hangga't hindi pa nakakapili ng appointment date ay maaari pa ring mai-edit ang mga impormasyon kagaya ng sa kurso at campus na gustong applyan.
Maaari bang ang magulang o guardian o kapatid o kaklase o school mate o kamag-anak ng aplikante ang pumunta sa mismong appointment date para sa validation ng application?

Pwede ang magulang o guardian o kapatid o kaklase o schoolmate o kamag-anak ang kumatawan sa aplikante sa mismong appointment date upang ipakita ang mga requirements para sa validation; magdala lamang ng authorization letter mula sa aplikante at isang photocopy ng valid ID ng aplikante.

Paano kung nagamit ko na ang aking gmail account sa pag-apply mula sa nakaraang admission application (SY 2026-2027)? Maaari ko pa bang gamitin ang parehong gmail account para mag-apply para sa kasalukuyang admission application (SY 2027-2028)?

Oo, pwedeng gamitin ang kaparehong gmail account na nagamit ng aplikante sa nakaraang admission application (SY2026-2027). Magkaiba ang admission system ng nakaraan at ng kasalukuyang system (SY2027-2028).
Saan makakakuha ng Certificate of Non-issuance of Form-137? Mayroon po bang request form para dito?
Makakakuha ng ganitong requirement sa inyong Senior High School. Walang request form para dito.
Maaari bang magpasa ng isang requirement na walang pirma ng Principal o Registrar o authorized school personnel?
Hindi. Kailangan ay mayroong pirma.
Kung ako ay kasalukuyang naka-enrolled sa ibang school/university, pwede kaya ako lumipat at mag-apply?
Maaaring subukan ng aplikante na mag-apply basta't maibigay niya ang lahat ng Certificate of Grades (COG) ng lahat ng semestre na kanyang pinag-enrol.
Ako ay dati nang estudyante ng CvSU. Gusto kong mag-aral muli. Paano ako makakapag-enroll?
Ang nagbabalik na estudyante ng CvSU ay dapat makipag-ugnayan muna sa kanilang College Registrar.
Paano ko ire-reset ang aking progress sa app?

Buksan ang Profile, pindutin ang Reset Admission Journey, at kumpirmahin ang Reset progress. Mabubura sa guide ang mga natapos na hakbang, mga naka-check na requirement, at naitalang resulta ng exam. Mananatiling naka-save ang iyong applicant profile.
Paano ko ie-edit ang aking applicant profile?
Buksan ang Profile at pindutin ang Edit Profile. Sundin ang mga hakbang sa setup at pindutin ang Continue sa huling screen upang ma-save ang iyong mga pinili.
Paano ko makukuha ang pinakabagong impormasyon sa guide?
Kumonekta sa internet, buksan ang Profile, at pindutin ang Check for content updates. Ida-download ng app ang pinakabagong na-publish na guide kapag available ito.
Magagamit ko ba ang app kahit walang internet?
Oo. Maaari mong basahin ang naka-save o kasamang guide sa app at gamitin ang campus map kahit offline. Kailangan ng internet para mag-download ng updates o buksan ang opisyal na admission portal.
Magagamit ko ba ang guide nang hindi gumagawa ng profile?
Oo. Piliin ang Continue as Guest sa unang screen. Maaari mong tingnan ang guide, mapa, at mga FAQ nang hindi sine-save ang iyong progress bilang aplikante.
Maaari ko bang isumite ang opisyal kong application sa app?
Pindutin ang Open CvSU Admission sa Home o Profile upang buksan ang opisyal na admission portal. Doon magsumite ng mga dokumento, pumili ng appointment, at tingnan ang opisyal na resulta.
Paano ko gagamitin ang walking guide sa campus map?
Buksan ang Map, pindutin ang marker ng pupuntahang lokasyon, at pumili ng gate o pindutin ang Start walking guide. Ipapakita ng karakter ang ruta patungo sa lokasyon.
Makikita ba ang aking progress sa ibang device?

Naka-save ang iyong profile at progress sa device na ginagamit mo. Kapag nagpalit ka ng cellphone o binura mo ang storage ng app, maaaring kailanganin mong i-set up muli ang profile at itala ulit ang iyong progress.
